rules: Provider and pack failures are not quality losses and must not be scored as zero-quality cases.
A completion failure is fail-soft only when pass-one projection survives; otherwise classify the records contract failure.
A candidate cannot pass on mean quality while any structural, readiness or provenance non-regression gate fails.
An unbased AI inference is a governed comparison metric, not an automatic case failure; a candidate may not increase its matched total.
An incomplete or configuration-mismatched pair is HOLD, never PASS or FAIL.
